answer: Farming becomes an ocean bet on surviving 89 epochs of grading, and every garden settlement recomputes the anchor schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 89 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
